_comment: Ordning: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ironman_guide (ändrad 26 okt 2026, hämtad 2026-11-24). Guiden delar bara in i faser (Early-game, Mid-game, Approaching late-game) och anger ingen ordning inom en fas, så ordningen inom paketet är ett eget förslag utifrån krav och nytta.
Guiden nämner under Early-game: Ardougne cloak 1, fairy rings (Lost City/Fairytale I), Graceful, Fighter torso, Dragon
defender och Barrows gloves (RFD markerar ofta övergången till mid-game). Ectophial, Dragon scimitar, Rune pouch, Bonecrusher,
Herb sack, Seed box och base 70 nämns inte; guiden säger att early game tränar skills till ungefär 60-70.
Avvikelse: guiden lägger Ava's assembler under Approaching late-game (Vorkath); den är med här enligt uppdraget.
Ardougne cloak och fairy rings är en referens till ardougne-cloak, som har båda (och cloak 1-4); så blir det inga dubbletter
mot diary-reward-templaten, som delar samma cloak-mål via dubblettregeln.
Paketet innehåller bara referenser till andra templates och anteckningar, ingen egen kravdata; delarna verifieras i
name: Early ironman
description: Early ironman unlocks in a suggested order, from the Ectophial to base 70

children.note: A short quest for an unlimited teleport to Port Phasmatys, used for Morytania trips all game.
Monkey Madness I gives the best early melee weapon and opens Ape Atoll.
The easy Ardougne Diary gives monastery teleports, and fairy rings open travel everywhere. Both early, as the guide suggests.
Lighter, faster travel on foot; the guide suggests it around 60 Agility, before heavy questing.
A common early milestone in the guide: strong melee strength bonus from Barbarian Assault.
A common early milestone in the guide: the best early off-hand for melee.
Frees inventory space for runes on every trip once you have slayer points.
The guide calls Recipe for Disaster a common end of the early game: the best gloves for a long time.
The best ranged cape slot. The guide places it after Vorkath, so it may come last here.
Buries bones automatically for Prayer XP while slaying, after the hard Morytania Diary.
Holds herbs on slayer tasks; bought with slayer points.
Holds seeds for farming runs; bought with Tithe Farm points.
The guide says the early game trains skills to about 60-70; base 70 rounds it off.
